snippet.title: Nine Realms: Revolt - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A story driven deckbuilding adventure set in a nordic world with an epic soundtrack. Roll your dice, then alter your dice and reinvent the fate of the realms! Build to suit your playstyle and discover an intricate plot from the eyes of a fledgling elven warrior.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465490/Nine_Realms_Revolt/
